notes: Transcribed by the app build from /workspace/mediterranean-research/feature-recommendations.md (2026-10-17). Replace with a research-supplied targets.json when available; scripts/sync-data.js prefers the research copy.

protein.text: Spread protein across meals, about 20-40 g each, from fish, beans and lentils, eggs, Greek yogurt or chicken.

sources.title: Jäger R et al. ISSN Position Stand: protein and exercise. JISSN 14:20
Morton RW et al. Meta-analysis of protein supplementation and resistance training. Br J Sports Med 52:376-84

sodium.fieldNote: Heavy sweating on field days raises sodium needs, so sodium isn't flagged today.

sources.title: Dietary Guidelines for Americans 2025-2030, sodium section

fiber.text: Mostly from whole grains, beans, vegetables, fruit and nuts.

sources.title: Reynolds A et al. Carbohydrate quality and human health. Lancet 393:434-45

recovery.text: After the hike, have a meal or snack with carbohydrate plus protein, like lentil soup with bread, or yogurt with fruit and oats.
recovery.backToBackText: Another field day within 24 hours: put extra carbohydrate in your recovery meals. Otherwise regular meals are enough.

sources.title: Thomas DT, Erdman KA, Burke LM. Nutrition and Athletic Performance (AND/DC/ACSM position statement). Med Sci Sports Exerc 48:543-68
Cederholm T et al. GLIM criteria for the diagnosis of malnutrition. Clin Nutr
Wilson MM et al. SNAQ. Am J Clin Nutr 82(5):1074-1081

socialEating.text: Low-appetite day? If you can, share a meal: field crew lunch or a family dinner. People tend to eat more with friends or family.

sources.title: Ruddock HK et al. Social facilitation of eating: systematic review and meta-analysis. Am J Clin Nutr 110:842-61
Harkin B et al. Does monitoring goal progress promote goal attainment? Psychol Bull 142:198-229
Samdal GB et al. Effective behaviour change techniques for physical activity and healthy eating. IJBNPA

medasSources.title: Schröder H et al. A Short Screener Is Valid for Assessing Mediterranean Diet Adherence among Older Spanish Men and Women. J Nutr 141:1140-45
